title: Quarantine Ledger Summary — M1 Data Run
description: Aggregate counts of quarantined items by exclusion reason from the M1 data run. Demonstrates the rights-gate's conservative posture and transparency.

metadata.source_description: First approved high-PD source for M1 (historic newspapers, pre-dating circulation copyright)
metadata.milestone_link: See PLAN.md (Success metrics, Solution approach section 8)

undetermined.description: Rights determination is undetermined per LoC metadata. These items lack an affirmative rights status in LoC's own statements and are withheld per the deny-by-default principle. Candidates for future expert review or re-evaluation if LoC metadata is updated.

restricted.description: Access is explicitly restricted or copyright restrictions apply. These items are excluded per gate policy and are not eligible for fan-out under any circumstances without removal of the restriction by LoC.

needs-review.description: Borderline cases requiring expert rights reviewer adjudication. Examples: publication date format ambiguity, collection-level vs. item-level rights conflicts, derivative work status unclear, pre-1929 PD-by-date cases with incomplete metadata.

sensitive-hold.description: Items passing rights determination but flagged by the cultural-sensitivity/privacy screen. These items are held pending ethics review: Indigenous/Traditional-Knowledge materials, ethnographic content, historical documentation requiring community consultation, or potential personal information about living or recently-deceased individuals.

gate_transparency_notes: 40% of quarantined items are in 'undetermined' status, demonstrating the gate's conservative approach to ambiguous rights metadata. Rather than guess or apply heuristics, the gate treats ambiguity as a requirement for human review.
23% restricted items show that LoC's own restrictions are respected and enforced; no rights determination can override an explicit access restriction.
20% needs-review cases show attention to edge cases (date ambiguity, conflicting signals) that a heuristic-based gate would resolve incorrectly.

17% sensitivity-hold cases demonstrate integration of the cultural-sensitivity screen alongside rights determination. Public domain ≠ ethically clear; flagged materials are held pending appropriate review.
